entities.name: Xeddick
entities.description: Sickly dead-white telepathic kraul of Ravnica, close ally of Vraska, killed by Aurelia.

entities.name: Vraska

entities.name: Jarad vod Savo

entities.description: Planeswalker who created a benign mindblock in Vraska's memories.

entities.description: Planeswalker whose invasion of the undercity led to Xeddick's death.

events.summary: Vraska befriended Xeddick, an outcast among his people.
